text:
alex: Quick sync — thinking of landing the token_cost + latency_label event changes tomorrow AM. Need: owners for attribution mapping, infra gating (topic/feature-flag), and a short smoke test plan. Who can own end-to-end?

maria: I can own the schema rollout and ingestion contract. PR is up: https://git.internal/r/redwood/data-event-schemas/pulls/42. Note: the new `latency_label` is optional but we want to start emitting for all generation responses.

jamal: infra needs to provision the topic and a compatibility flag so we can route new events to the new pipeline without dropping old ones. pinging @infra-bot for ticket id.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-2873 — provisioning new topic `token-metrics-v2` + FF `token_metrics_v2` gated by org. ETA: 12h.

sophia: Product heads-up: billing will read from attribution table — confirm that `attribution_key` won't change semantics. Also any risk to current customer dashboards?

maria: attribution_key is the same (user_id|model_version). We're adding `cost_origin` enum (direct, cache, batch) to help rollups. No breaking change.

lina: For canary we need latency slices exposed so SRE can validate p50/p95 per route. Quick SQL I used for a smoke check:

```
SELECT route, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95,
       count(*) as hits
FROM events.token_metrics_v2
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

lina: Also set an alert if p95 increases by >25% vs baseline for 5m window.

alex: Good — can we get owners for the following: schema rollout (maria), infra gating (jamal), canary test and SLO validation (lina), billing validation (sophia), SDK emit changes (who on client SDK?).

maria: ack for schema rollout. I'll post a migration checklist in the PR description.

jamal: ack for infra gating. I'll coordinate with infra on the FF rollout plan and make sure the topic is replicated.

sophia: I'll confirm billing read model compatibility and run the dashboard smoke after canary.

alex: SDK change — @jamal or @maria do we have a short client patch that adds `latency_label` and `cost_origin` to events? If not, we need an owner for that.

maria: We need +1 on SDK repo. @lina or @jamal can you nominate someone from devexp? Otherwise I can open a small PR but won't be able to handle rollouts for all languages.

lina: I can shepherd the JS + Python patches. Will create PRs today.

alex: Blockers? Anything that would push the canary beyond tomorrow AM?

jamal: Only potential blocker is cross-region topic replication verification. If replication fails we can't safe-canary global traffic. Estimating worst-case delay 24h.

maria: One more note — we need to update event contract docs and the example payload. Sample payload in PR: 

```
{
  "event": "token_cost",
  "attribution_key": "user_123|gptx-1",
  "cost_units": 12,
  "latency_ms": 230,
  "latency_label": "inference_main",
  "cost_origin": "direct",
  "ts": "2026-03-17T09:12:34Z"
}
```

alex: Perfect. Action items summary:
- maria: merge schema PR + doc updates (owner)
- jamal: infra ticket INF-2873, feature flag rollout (owner)
- lina: SDK patches + canary smoke tests (owner)
- sophia: billing/dashboard validation post-canary
- alex: coordinate canary window + notify customers if needed

maria: I'll tag the PR with `migration-checklist` and add a backfill note if we need to recompute attribution for last 48h.

jamal: I'll post a final go/no-go message here once INF-2873 has provisioned and replication verified.

lina: will post smoke test results in this thread after the canary (link to dashboard if any anomalies). :eyes: :rocket:

sophia: thanks all — appreciate the quick turn.

alex: :thumbsup: If no objections, plan to start canary at 2026-03-18T06:00Z. Reply with :+1: to acknowledge ownership or mention if you can't.

maria: :+1:

jamal: :+1:

lina: :+1:

sophia: :+1:
